title: Implement opt-in Math SI electrochemical unit profile with twelve targeted source tests
commitMessage: feat: add explicit Math electrochemical SI unit profile with exact dimensions

contribution.summary: Add six originally authored SI electrical/molar units to an explicit Math-owned profile without altering either historical catalogue or previously published package.
contribution.value: Compile the new ElectrochemicalUnitProfile using existing exact rational, dimension and quantity contracts; execute twelve selected source tests for each unit, legacy catalogue identity, two electric products, molar inverse, and actual incompatible unit refusals.
debtChanges: AURA U-N checkpoint c818346f identifies absent electrical/molar units in both the 58-entry inherited and 14-entry standard catalogues; no manually assembled consumer definitions count.
RS172 succeeded at attempt 001 after one pre-attempt refusal; F38 Numerics provenance is reconciled and all published packages remain immutable.
AURA code reuse rights remain not established. New source is original Math work; no public SPDX/license, AURA modification or sibling repository mutation is authorized.
RS173 only qualifies source-compiled Math tests. A new exact-version dw.quantities.standard package and independent PackageReference-only consumer must be qualified before local release.

RS173 first invocation was refused before attempt allocation: payload manually created a disposable TRX directory, which DWF forbids. The correction delegates directory creation to dotnet test; the same twelve-case qualification and mutation boundary are retained.
contribution.nextAction: Prepare a fresh calendar-version dw.quantities.standard NuGet candidate using exact Quantities/Expression packages, qualify an isolated PackageReference consumer, then publish without overwrite to NUGET_LOCAL and independently reread the published archives.
